```{r}
############################################################
# METHOD 3 SIMULATION: Grouped jackknife CI for beta1
############################################################
set.seed(406)

inv_logit <- function(z) 1/(1+exp(-z))

beta0 <- -1.2
beta1 <- -0.06
betaF <-  0.35
beta2 <-  0.01
betaInt <- -0.05

gen_X <- function(n) {
  mvpa <- pmin(pmax(round(rnorm(n, mean = 6, sd = 3)), 0), 15)
  female <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.52)
  data.frame(mvpa_week = mvpa, female = female)
}

genY_A <- function(X) {
  eta <- beta0 + beta1*X$mvpa_week + betaF*X$female
  rbinom(nrow(X), 1, inv_logit(eta))
}
genY_B <- function(X) {
  eta <- beta0 + beta1*X$mvpa_week + beta2*(X$mvpa_week^2) + betaF*X$female
  rbinom(nrow(X), 1, inv_logit(eta))
}
genY_C <- function(X) {
  eta <- beta0 + beta1*X$mvpa_week + betaF*X$female + betaInt*(X$mvpa_week*X$female)
  rbinom(nrow(X), 1, inv_logit(eta))
}

fit_beta1 <- function(df) {
  fit <- glm(obese ~ mvpa_week + female, family = binomial(), data = df)
  unname(coef(fit)["mvpa_week"])
}

jackknife_ci <- function(df, G = 50, alpha = 0.05) {
  n <- nrow(df)
  grp <- sample(rep(1:G, length.out = n))
  theta_full <- fit_beta1(df)
  theta_g <- numeric(G)
  for (g in 1:G) {
    theta_g[g] <- fit_beta1(df[grp != g, , drop = FALSE])
  }
  theta_bar <- mean(theta_g)
  var_jk <- (G - 1)/G * sum((theta_g - theta_bar)^2)
  se_jk <- sqrt(var_jk)
  z <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)
  ci <- c(theta_full - z*se_jk, theta_full + z*se_jk)
  list(est = theta_full, ci = ci)
}

run_m3 <- function(genY, scenario_name, M = 500, n = 3000, G = 50) {
  est <- numeric(M); cover <- numeric(M); width <- numeric(M); rt <- numeric(M)
  for (m in 1:M) {
    if (m %% 25 == 0) message(scenario_name, ": ", m, "/", M)
    X <- gen_X(n)
    y <- genY(X)
    df <- cbind(X, obese = y)

    t0 <- proc.time()[3]
    out <- jackknife_ci(df, G = G)
    rt[m] <- proc.time()[3] - t0

    est[m] <- out$est
    cover[m] <- as.numeric(out$ci[1] <= beta1 && beta1 <= out$ci[2])
    width[m] <- out$ci[2] - out$ci[1]
  }
  data.frame(
    scenario = scenario_name,
    M = M, n = n, G_groups = G,
    truth_beta1 = beta1,
    bias = mean(est - beta1),
    mc_sd = sd(est),
    mse = mean((est - beta1)^2),
    coverage = mean(cover),
    exp_width = mean(width),
    mean_runtime_sec = mean(rt)
  )
}

res_A <- run_m3(genY_A, "A_linear", M = 300, n = 3000, G = 50)
res_B <- run_m3(genY_B, "B_quadratic", M = 300, n = 3000, G = 50)
res_C <- run_m3(genY_C, "C_interaction", M = 300, n = 3000, G = 50)

out <- rbind(res_A, res_B, res_C)
print(out)
saveRDS(out, file = "method3_jackknife_results.rds")

```
